summary: Customer Ratings & Reviews end-to-end testing for Culinary Editorial F&B template. Backend pytest suite (15 cases, 14 passed, 1 skipped) all green. Frontend e2e validated: Product Detail Page reviews, Menu rating pills (only for items with reviews — correct), Admin /admin/reviews tabs (Moderation/Insights/Settings), respond dialog, sidebar Reviews link, all data-testids present and clickable.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminReviews.js is 567 lines — consider splitting Moderation/Insights/Settings tabs into separate files for maintainability.

Default Moderation tab statusFilter is 'attention' which renders the friendly empty state when nothing is flagged. Intentional but slightly surprising — a small subtitle 'Showing reviews needing your attention' next to the title would aid clarity.
/api/admin/reviews/aggregate iterates the full reviews collection in Python (line 531). Acceptable today but should switch to a Mongo aggregation pipeline before production scale (>10k reviews).
/api/reviews/{id}/helpful is unauthenticated and unrate-limited — anyone can spam the helpful counter. Consider adding session-based dedupe or rate-limit once traffic warrants.
ReviewSubmissionPage validates eligibility client-side only via /reviews/request/{order_id}; the backend does also enforce it on POST /reviews — good defense in depth, no change needed.

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/14 executed pytest cases passed; 1 admin-delete-permanent skipped per design — keeps seed intact)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all flows verified: PDP reviews+sort+filter+helpful, menu pills, admin Moderation/Insights/Settings tabs, respond dialog, sidebar)

seed_data_creation: No new seed required. Existing seed has 9 reviews across 5 items (item-001, item-002, item-004, item-006, item-009) plus one admin response.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Customer Reviews fully working. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_reviews.py uses MongoClient to flip orders to 'delivered' for the submission flow. ReviewSubmissionPage requires guest contact_email match for guest orders — pattern: create order via POST /api/orders, set status='delivered' + delivered_at older than auto_send_delay_minutes (default 60), then visit /review/<order_id>. Default Moderation tab is 'attention' (low-rated unresponded reviews) — switch to 'Approved' to see seeded data. Sidebar 'Reviews' link added under /admin/reviews.
